description:
Bitwarden secures credentials and secrets for millions of users and tens of thousands of organizations worldwide. Our platform spans three products: Password Manager, Privileged Controls, and Secrets Manager. Open source, independently audited, and built for transparency, Bitwarden is trusted by security teams who need to verify what they deploy.

With FedRAMP authorization on the horizon and a growing installed base across federal agencies, states, counties, and municipalities, we are investing to make Public Sector a core growth engine for the business.

The Role

We are hiring a Public Sector Account Executive to win and grow Bitwarden's business across Federal, State, and Local government. You will own a blended territory, carry a quota, and run full-cycle sales — from first conversation with an agency CISO to a signed order through the right contract vehicle.

This is a ground-floor seat on a team being built now. You'll inherit real revenue, real agency logos, and a product roadmap purpose-built for government security requirements, and you'll help shape the playbook as our FedRAMP offering comes to market. You will report to the Vice President of Public Sector and work closely with Sales Development, Solutions Engineering, Partners, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance.

What You'll Own

Quota and Pipeline

  • Carry and exceed an annual quota across a blended Federal, State, and Local territory
  • Build territory and account plans that map agency missions, budget cycles, and security priorities to Bitwarden's products
  • Generate your own pipeline through agency outreach, events, and partner co-selling, in partnership with Sales Development
  • Maintain an accurate, disciplined forecast in the CRM and contribute to weekly forecast calls and deal reviews

Full-Cycle Selling

  • Run complex sales cycles end to end: discovery, technical evaluation with Solutions Engineering, pricing, procurement, and close
  • Sell to multiple stakeholders at once — CISOs, IT and security leaders, program offices, and contracting officers
  • Expand existing agency accounts across Password Manager, Privileged Controls, and Secrets Manager
  • Navigate fiscal-year timing, including end-of-year buying windows and appropriation rhythms

Contract Vehicles and Partners

  • Close business through Bitwarden's existing vehicles — including our NASPO ValuePoint agreement via Carahsoft — and the resellers and distributors that carry them
  • Guide customers to the right purchasing path, including GSA MAS, NASA SEWP, state term contracts, and cooperative purchasing agreements
  • Co-sell with value-added resellers, systems integrators, and prime contractors to reach agencies and programs
  • Flag vehicle gaps that block deals, and feed them into the team's contract vehicle strategy

Compliance-Led Selling

  • Position Bitwarden's FedRAMP authorization path, FIPS validation, and open source transparency as reasons to buy
  • Support agency ATO processes alongside Compliance and Solutions Engineering
  • Respond to RFIs, RFPs, and sources-sought notices with Legal, Compliance, and Proposal support

Voice of the Customer

  • Bring government requirements (StateRAMP, CJIS, agency-level controls) back to Product and Sales leadership
  • Partner with Marketing on public sector events, campaigns, and customer references
  • Represent Bitwarden professionally with agency leadership and procurement officials

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying software sales into U.S. Public Sector, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets
  • Experience selling into both Federal and State & Local government — not exclusively one or the other
  • Working knowledge of government procurement: contract vehicles, GWACs, cooperative agreements, fiscal-year cycles, and the reseller/distributor channel
  • Experience selling cybersecurity, identity, or infrastructure software to security and IT buyers
  • Proven ability to self-source pipeline and run multi-stakeholder, multi-month sales cycles
  • Comfort in a high-growth environment where the playbook is still being written

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience selling a FedRAMP-authorized product, or supporting agencies through the ATO process
  • Existing relationships across federal civilian, DoD, and/or large state agencies
  • Familiarity with identity security, PAM, or secrets management
  • Experience co-selling with Carahsoft or other government distributors, resellers, and systems integrators
  • Experience at an open source or developer-adjacent company

Why Bitwarden

  • Mission. Our community loves us, and you'll bring better security to everyone from families to the world's largest organizations.
  • Market. You'll become an expert in two growing markets: security and open-source software.
  • Growth. You'll build channel, demand gen, and product-led growth experience in a fast-growing company.
  • Team. Work remotely with motivated people around the world, with in-person meet ups.

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $100,000k - $125,000k. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.

Bitwarden is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
